agent.answer:
For your 10 October 2026 trip, July, August and September count: 1 July–30 September 2026. Eligibility updates on 2 October; only 1 October carries September’s status. Your supplied ₹12,000 eligible billed debit spend exceeds the ₹10,000 requirement. From 1 October, UPI, wallet reloads, credit card bill payments and cash/ATM transactions are excluded. [axis-priority-2026]

You have 2 of 2 complimentary domestic visits remaining for the October–December quarter, with 0 used. The monthly eligibility update does not reset the quarterly visit allowance. [axis-product]

Yes, Encalm Lounge at Delhi (DEL) T3 domestic is listed for your selected Priority debit card in the reviewed directory: Table 3, page 4, row 23. [axis-lounges]

The reviewed verdict is qualified: published benefit conditions are met under your supplied facts. Your unknown account type does not add a missing requirement for this reviewed card variant. Exact lounge admission is separately subject to the reviewed directory, bank/card validation and operator validation, including capacity; entry is not guaranteed. [axis-priority-2026] [axis-lounges]
